name: jev-context
description: Advises when a big Claude Code context is worth compacting or clearing, and keeps a searchable log of past sessions. Advice only: it never runs /compact or /clear.

toolkitPath.title: jev-toolkit folder
toolkitPath.description: Absolute path to your jev-toolkit checkout (the folder with pyproject.toml and .venv). Empty: the JEV_TOOLKIT environment variable is used.
